integrity.mathematical_origin: A constructive theorem based on the established incidence-matrix orientation identity.
integrity.proof_status: Analytic proof with separate finite computational cross-checks.
integrity.published_source_claim: Bal's original orientation characterization, global bounds and single-cycle examples are explicitly credited; no claim of independent certification.

scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs with pairwise vertex-disjoint cycle blocks only; no coverage of cacti with shared cycle vertices.
Distinct labeled sign assignments are counted within the canonical signed-line switching class, rather than switching-isomorphism classes.
Computer enumeration verifies finite instances only; the proof is combinatorial and all-order.
Independent external audit has not been performed.
title: Exact signed-line frustration and minimum-signature census for vertex-disjoint-cycle cacti
